profile.headline: Software Developer (Full Stack) at Linbis Logistics Software
profile.summary:
Professional with more than 6 years of experience in variuos stage of the software development process. My expertise include  web and desktop applications implementation,  database design,  sql and ORM.  I Believe in good practices and programming techniques such as design patterns and SOLID principles. 

As a team player with excellent interpersonal skills, I'm equally comfortable working independently or as part of a group. I enjoy taking initiative and believe in the importance of fostering strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders alike.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer
	●	ASP.NET/.NET Core MVC using C# and front-end technologies like Angular.
	●	REST web service and microservices architectures.
	●	Docker for building and testing applications.
	●	Development of an API for the consumption of new services.
	●	Business Logic layer using ASP.Net framework.
	●	UI made with MVC 5(razor) and Bootstrap.
	●	Participate in Scrum activities such as creating user stories, and sprint retrospectives.
	●	SQL data access using entity framework 6 database first capacity. (LINQ)
	●	Web protocols, such as HTTP/HTTPS.

Technologies used: ASP.NET MVC 5, Web API, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Bootstrap 3, Entity framework 6, ASP.NET/.NET, SQL Server 2019, LINQ, C#, Visual Studio 2019 and 2022.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer
	●	Website development and maintenance, implementing bootstrap to improve responsive design.
	●	Working in ASP.NET/.NET Core MVC Website to provide new features.
	●	Data access layer using entity framework 6.
	●	Implemented new endpoints of several API.
	●	Web protocols, such as HTTP/HTTPS.

Technologies used: C#, ASP.NET/.NET, MVC, HTML, JavaScript, Bootstrap 3, Visual Studio, Razor.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer
	●	Design and development of new software features and functionalities using technologies such as ASP.NET C#, Angular and SQL Server with a strong focus on creating and generating business value.
	●	Development of high-quality, scalable and maintainable systems using a service-oriented architecture.
	●	Analysis of system deficiencies and propose/implement effective solutions.
	●	Identify and communicate technical risks and propose mitigation actions.
	●	Web protocols, such as HTTP/HTTPS.

Technologies used: C#, ASP.NET, MVC, HTML,SQL Server, LINQ, JavaScript, Bootstrap 3, Visual Studio, Razor.
